description: At languid flame the withered tongues of menWhispered frightfully a name beyond ken.But fit the cosmic-shadowed dancer sawTo grant their timeworn audience twilight's fall.Behold, shattered carapace of mine flesh—Behold! That which is dead shall live again!Colors in hues too ill for mortal eyes;Pulsing static, ichoric, breathless cries—Echoed thunder, hollow ring: cloudless skiesCould not bear the curse of ancient demise—And here, I rise. Smoldering with greater vice.I turn, and burn; there will be nothing leftWhen I am sated. And all that is, shall restIn ash and dust. Even time will forgetThat once there was love. Hate. Perhaps regret.Only hunger remains. For I aloneIn dim memory recall the last that shone.The ones before that showed me the way home.
summon:
Some are compelled to consume.
Others hunger to be devoured.
You'll know which one you are, soon enough.
evolution:
This pleases me.
But not for long.
